headline.caveat: two JPMorgan-led construction loans: $2.3B (phase 1, Oct 2024) + $7.1B (phase 2, May 2025); JPMorgan's own hold vs consortium share undisclosed

realized_to_date.caveat: construction loans draw as the eight buildings progress; drawn amounts not disclosed

nature_md: A JPMorgan-led consortium provides the construction debt for the Stargate Abilene campus: $2.3B for phase 1 (two buildings, Oct 2024) and $7.1B for phase 2 (six more buildings, May 2025; arranged by Newmark) — the first Stargate site to obtain major bank construction financing. The loans sit on the Crusoe/Blue Owl/Primary Digital JV and are supported by the campus and its Oracle lease serving OpenAI.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Senior secured construction lending held/syndicated by the JPMorgan-led group — bank balance-sheet exposure to a single-tenant AI campus whose credit chains to Oracle/OpenAI; a named component of the banking system's growing AI C&I book.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Project-level debt of the JV — off the balance sheets of OpenAI, Oracle, and the sponsors individually. Refinancing risk at stabilization is a watch item as AI credit spreads widen.

events.title: JPMorgan leads $7.1B construction loan for Stargate Abilene phase 2
